plan: A marksman who scatters feathers on the ground then recalls them to root her enemies.
aSurveiller: Her E (Bladecaller). She recalls her feathers, which root after 3 hits: don't stand between her and her feathers.
contrer: Don't stand between her and her feathers on the ground: her E recalls them.
Her R makes her untargetable: save your spells for after.
Engage her: she has few escapes.

sorts.P: After a spell, her attacks pierce and leave feathers.

momentFort: Strong in the mid and late game.
